record.question: According to IS: 1893- 2002, the value of the horizontal seismic coefficient for any structure with natural period of vibration in second (T) ≤ 0.1 cannot be less than Z/2 (Z= Zone factor of the seismic zone). The horizon seismic coefficient for seismic zone V is:
record.explanation: Zone V has Z = 0.36 under IS 1893:2002; Z/2 = 0.18. No exact official key match is established for this paper in the current archive crosswalk.
